Schnittstelle MemoisingPred<A>

Typparameter:
A - the input type
Alle Superschnittstellen:
Pred<A>, Predicate<A>
public interface MemoisingPred<A> extends Pred<A>

A functional interface for memoized predicates. Caches results by input to avoid repeated evaluation on identical arguments.

Contract:

  • Inputs must not be null.
  • The wrapped predicate SHOULD be referentially transparent (pure): for equal inputs it must always produce equal results and must not rely on or cause observable side effects.
  • The cache is unbounded and keyed by the input's equality semantics (Object.equals(Object) and Object.hashCode()).
Seit:
1.0.0

  • Methodendetails

    • memoisingPred

      static <A> MemoisingPred<A> memoisingPred(@NonNull Pred<A> pred)

      Creates a memoizing wrapper over the given Pred. The returned predicate caches results for previously seen inputs and returns cached values on subsequent calls with equal inputs.

      Contract:

      • pred must not be null; inputs must not be null.
      • The wrapped predicate SHOULD be pure/referentially transparent.
      • The cache is unbounded and uses the input's equals/hashCode for keying.
      Typparameter:
      A - the input type
      Parameter:
      pred - the predicate to memoize; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a memoizing predicate wrapper
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if pred is null
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • clear

      MemoisingPred<A> clear()

      Clears all cached results so that subsequent calls re-evaluate the predicate instead of returning cached ones.

      Gibt zurück:
      this MemoisingPred instance (for method chaining)
